observation_summary: Operations on KeyedObjects2D throw UnknownKeyException or ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException because the internal data structures are out of sync after a removal operation.
reasoning_summary: The root cause is that the KeyedObjects2D class maintains internal state (rowKeys, columnKeys, and the rows list) that becomes desynchronized when rows or columns are removed. Specifically, when a row or column is removed, the class fails to update the underlying data structures consistently across all rows. This leads to subsequent operations (like getObject or removeColumn) attempting to access or remove keys that no longer exist or are indexed incorrectly, triggering UnknownKeyException or ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
